name: Sunrise flow
description: A steady vinyasa to wake up to: breath, sun salutations and a long stretch at the end. Mats are provided.

name: Strength basics
description: Squats, hinges, pushes and pulls with kettlebells, at your own weight. Good for a first class.

name: Pottery wheel
description: Centre, open and pull your first bowls on the wheel. Clay and firing are included.

name: Breathwork
description: Half an hour of guided breathing over lunch. Come as you are.

name: Spin sprint
description: Intervals on the bike to loud music. Bring water and a towel.

name: Slow stretch
description: Long held stretches and a little yin to end the week.
